blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The suggestion from Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro that Vice President Sara Duterte can use other platforms to respond to evidence that the prosecution has presented but later withdrew is ridiculous and unbelievable, lead counsel for the respondent Sheila Sison said on Tuesday. During the resumption of Duterte’s trial, Sison again called out Luistro after the latter responded to questions about whether it would be fair for the defense if they were not allowed to counter evidence simply because the prosecution withdrew Articles I, III, and IV.
